description.value: Angry Otter Liquor is a co-operatively owned retail liquor store operated by Otter Co-op, a locally-rooted co-operative serving communities across the Fraser Valley and Okanagan. Located near the Whatcom area of Chilliwack (per its alt name), it is a convenient resupply stop for touring cyclists passing through the region. As part of the Otter Co-op network, membership is open to the public.
